title: “Titus Andronicus” starring Patrick Page is running at Red Bull Theat...
transcript: a production of Shakespeare's most gruesome and gory play is running in New York right now starring Broadway icon Patrick Page and it's a wild time! if you're not familiar with Titus Andronicus it famously has the highest death toll in any Shakespeare play and some additional twisted, disturbing violence in between. the play doesn't get performed all that often which is a shame because it's pretty entertaining it stands apart from a lot of Shakespeare's other work but this revenge tragedy genre was actually quite popular in the Jacobean and late Elizabethan era when this was written. and I find with this genre that because they're already so over the top and excessive they tend to play best nowadays with a bit of an undercurrent of humor to it almost with a camp factor. this production directed by Jesse Berger definitely had some of that though it sometimes felt a little uncertain about where it wanted its tone to land otherwise though I thought this was a really solid production they cut the text down to a very tightly focused 2h15m or so including the intermission which made it feel very digestible (no pun intended) without losing anything from the essence of the play and it's a fairly traditional production otherwise so I'd say this is a pretty good first intro to Titus Andronicus for anyone who's not familiar with it I went with my friend who went into it blind and it was really fun to kind of watch her experience it for the first time honestly I think this production makes for a better intro to the material than the Julie Taymor movie but this one is only running in New York through May 3rd so if you have the opportunity and if you think you can handle the blood and gore I would recommend it
reasoning: Clear recommendation with praise for the tight runtime and accessibility, but noted tonal uncertainty as a caveat. Solidly positive rather than rave.
